target: mr/content-length-remainder working tree; source hashes bind validated code and tests; documentation added afterwards.
scope: Project-owned differential corpus, not full upstream EUnit/PropEr suites. No Cowlib implementation or upstream test bodies vendored.
cause: Tail-call lowering forwarded an internal binary match cursor to a generic parameter fallback, allowing it to escape in a tuple and encode as undefined. BIF calls also received internal cursors and raised badarg.
fix: Only local argument positions with a binary pattern in every function clause accept cursor forwarding. Other arguments materialize into real Erlang binaries; safe binary-only loops retain reuse. Materialization now packs unaligned bit windows and preserves partial final bytes while retaining the aligned zero-copy path.

regression_red.source: Observed tool output before production edits; serialization assertion retained in final test.

materialization_red.assertion: result.binary_bit_size() equals the requested bit count

materialization_green.note: Unit regression passes, including all offsets, partial bytes, heap/refcounted inputs and cursor inputs. Also included in final workspace tests.

intermediate_native_failure.note: Compiler boundary fix initially exposed pre-existing bit materialization truncation. This is a failed intermediate attempt, not a successful gate.

native_parallel.note: Parallel run retained as a failed attempt; variance failure passed an isolated serial rerun. Final serial gate recorded separately.

regression_green.note: binary_tail_guard_fallback passed in the final serial suite; same test source also passed on BEAM.
